prompts.camp: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Hearth Village location artwork. Remove the large leaf mask monument in the middle completely, including its plinth. Replace that occupied space with a small open courtyard and simple stepping stones continuing between the cottages. Preserve the three charming cream cottages, their swooping leaf-shaped roofs, tiny fence, bushes, composition and identity very closely. This is a standalone illustrated world-map location sprite, not an entire map. Flat SVG-like vector illustration with simple solid cel-colour regions, confident dark walnut ink, restrained warm sepia/tan/cream palette. Preserve reference proportions and hand-drawn curves. No mask, face, deity, lettering, banner, cast shadow or background. True transparent background including gaps around the buildings. Entire silhouette isolated with a small transparent margin. No gradients, painterly texture, photographic lighting or extra scenery.
prompts.shop: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached lantern tree location artwork. Reimagine it as ONE massive ancient tree, with a broad single gnarled trunk and a magnificent unified crown, exposed curling roots and a small warm lantern hanging from one low curling branch. Remove the mask and its plinth completely. The trunk should feel genuinely huge, a memorable ancient tree location, not two trees making an arch. Keep the friendly curling botanical shapes and golden-tan leafy canopy of the reference, a small leafy ground edge and roots, a simple hollow in the trunk is welcome. No face or mask shapes anywhere. Standalone world-map location sprite. Same flat SVG-like cel shapes, confident dark walnut contours and restrained warm sepia/tan/cream palette. Simple legible silhouette at small size; no excessive detail. Entire tree fully inside the frame, transparent background and transparent openings between branches. No labels, banner, people, gradients, texture, cast shadow or background.
prompts.shrine: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Fallen Shrine location artwork. Replace the central giant mask stone with an evocative little ruined sanctuary: a broken stone archway with empty opening, crumbling uneven walls, short worn stairs, scattered masonry and a little creeping foliage. No masks, faces, eyes, statues, deities or symbols. Keep it an asymmetric cluster of old architectural ruins in the same compact footprint, same view and same restrained warm sepia sandstone/cream/tan colours. Standalone world-map location sprite with flat SVG-like solid cel shapes and dark walnut drawn contours, rounded imperfect edges. Match the reference's hand-drawn storybook style, not realistic medieval 3D. Transparent background including the archway opening, clean complete isolated silhouette with margin. No lettering, banner, background, cast shadow, gradients or painterly texture.
